boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 特富野古道自忠端（海拔2,275m，林務局官方資料）沿舊鐵道雲霧森林與柳杉林展望（forest.gov.tw 步道頁＋OSM trailhead 節點）；清單主題的茶園季窗與本站古道主體不符，誠實不建時間窗契約——本契約為古道雲霧林主體；與既有 tw-024 阿里山祝山觀日平台（3.36km）題材錯位——本點為森林古道，祝山為觀日平台。
boosters_i18n.en: Mist forest and old-railway cedar woods from the Zizhong entrance of the Tefuya Historic Trail (2,275 m, Forestry Bureau page; OSM trailhead node); the list's teaterrace window doesn't fit the trail subject - honestly no window contract. Disjoint from tw-024 Zhushan sunrise platform 3.36 km away (trail forest vs sunrise platform).
boosters_i18n.ja: 特富野古道自忠側（標高2,275m、林務局）の霧の森と旧線（OSM）。茶園の季節窓は不構築。祝山観日平台とは題材が別。

penalties_i18n.en: Severe weather, poor visibility, outside operating/season window.
penalties_i18n.ja: 悪天候、視程不良、営業・季節窓外。
